courses.synopsis: Lettering and line work, Angles, Triangles, Quadrilaterals, inscribing a circle in any regular polygon and inscribing any regular polygon in a circle, Conic sections: drawing the true shape of the section of the frustum of the cylinder. Development of simple engineering/fabricated objects such as: – frustum of cylinder and a pyramid. The ellipse: ellipse by the rectangular method, auxiliary circle method, trammel method and by foci method. Common internal and external tangent to two equal and unequal circles, internal and external arc of a given radii.
